title: Zip files and folders
steps: Select the files or folder you want to zip (hold Ctrl and click to pick several).
Right-click the selection and choose Compress to > ZIP File.
If you don't see Compress to, select Show more options > Send to > Compressed (zipped) folder.
A zipped folder with the same name appears in the same place; type a new name if you like and press Enter.

title: Rename a file
steps: In File Explorer, select the file you want to rename.
Select Rename on the toolbar, press F2, or right-click the file and select Rename.
Type the new name and press Enter.

title: Create a new folder
steps: Press Windows logo key + E to open File Explorer.
Go to the place where you want the new folder.
Type a name for the folder and press Enter.
